tool.name: Fuel Cycle UQ
tool.description: Tritium fuel cycle Monte Carlo uncertainty quantification

param.name: mean_tbr
param.label: Mean Tritium Breeding Ratio (TBR)
param.help: Dataset containing a single float: the mean TBR from the OpenMC simulation.

param.name: std_tbr
param.label: Standard deviation of TBR
param.help: Dataset containing a single float: the TBR std dev from the OpenMC simulation.

param.name: fuelling_rate
param.label: Fuelling rate (kg/s)
param.help: Tritium fuelling rate in kg per second. Converted internally to kg/h.

param.name: h
param.label: Time step size (h)
param.help: Integration step size for the Euler solver in hours. Smaller values increase accuracy and runtime.

param.name: samples
param.label: Number of Monte Carlo samples
param.help: Number of independent TBR samples drawn for uncertainty quantification.

tool.help:
**Fuel Cycle Uncertainty Quantification**
Simulates tritium inventory dynamics in a fusion fuel cycle using both an exact analytical solution and a forward-Euler numerical solver. Monte Carlo sampling over the Tritium Breeding Ratio (TBR) propagates uncertainty through the system.
-----
**Inputs**
- **Mean TBR** — The mean tritium breeding ratio. TBR > 1 means more tritium is bred than burned. Values around 1.05–1.15 are typical design targets.
- **Fuelling rate** — Total tritium fuel input rate in kg/s. Determines how much tritium enters the plasma per unit time.
- **Start / End time** — Simulation window in hours. A value of 2400 h ≈ 100 days.
- **Time step** — Euler integration step. Values of 0.1 h are usually sufficient; use smaller steps only if checking numerical accuracy.
- **Monte Carlo samples** — Number of independent TBR realisations. 1000 samples give good PDF estimates; use 10 000 for publication-quality results.
-----
**Outputs**
1. **Histogram PNG** — Probability density of tritium in storage at the final time step, overlaid with a Gaussian fit.
2. **Time-series PNG** — Mean storage trajectory (exact and Euler) with ±1σ band.
3. **CSV data** — Comma-separated file with columns: ``time_h``, ``exact_mean_kg``, ``exact_std_kg``, ``euler_mean_kg``, ``euler_std_kg``
-----
**Model equations**
The out-of-facility and in-facility inventories follow first-order ODEs driven by the burn rate and TBR. Storage tritium accumulates from IFC returns minus plasma consumption. See the companion MATLAB reference (Project_marvel.m) for the full analytical derivation.
